inventory.bindUse Sets what using an item does: an action set run through the outbox; null makes the item unusable.
inventory.grantStarting Sets how many of an item an inventory starts with (0 removes the line).
inventory.placeItem Places an item in a region as a world item the player can pick up once (action ref inventory.pickup).
inventory.setPrice Sets an item's base price; with a vendor, sets that vendor's buy price for the item instead (-1 = the item's price).
inventory.setStock Sets a vendor's stock line: count (or unlimited), the price the player pays and the price the vendor pays.
project.build Build a player through the build lane. NotConfigured until a build lane is registered.
project.launch Launch the last (or a named) build through the build lane. NotConfigured until a build lane is registered.
project.reload Refresh the AssetDatabase, forget cached types and tools, and rebuild the semantic index. Returns the new index and catalog revisions.
project.save Save dirty assets and every open scene (the journal is independent of saving: an entry can be Applied and unsaved).
